provenance.axial_treatment: axially reflective slab; axial leakage carried separately as Bz^2 in operators.assemble_AF
provenance.homogenization: flux-volume weighted over transport-resolved constituents; Sigma_tr homogenized, then D = 1/(3 Sigma_tr)

fuel_pebble.kind: single fuel pebble (explicit TRISO) in a reflective FLiBe cell

depletion.note: isotopics from one representative unit cell PER FUEL ZONE; the collapse spectrum is still the full-core one

model_notes.geometry_source: gFHR benchmark (Satvat et al. 2021 / INL VTB) for dimensions and materials; Hermes (NRC KP-TR-024-NP, ML24095A258) for the 4 reflector control + 3 in-bed shutdown element count
